versions.changelog:
Initial release of LazyAds MCP skill.

- Manage ad campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, Reddit, Apple, Bing, ChatGPT, and Snapchat from a single interface.
- Supports both Bridge mode (BYOA) for manual workflow and Full MCP (Starter+) for AI-powered campaign automation, creative generation, optimisation, and competitor intelligence.
- Over 45 tools to create, edit, sync, analyse, and optimise campaigns.
- Easy setup with API key and unified endpoint.
- Works with live campaign import, ad creative management, platform connection, real-time performance sync, and campaign breakdowns.
- Detailed tool descriptions and usage examples provided in documentation.
